validation: Both default D:\NVENV.TXT and compile-time A:/NVUI.TXT builds compile with strict warnings and no CRT.
Real XP main-thread proxy guest reads SCREEN_SAVER_ACTIVE1, timeout600 and DISPLAY_AC1200.
Explicit application returns SCREEN_SAVER_SET1/POWER_SET1 and independently reads SCREEN_SAVER_ACTIVE0 with all six idle timeouts0.
A 1.44MiB RAM tools floppy provides bounded output; original OS/game images are served read-only.
limits: This confirms and prepares the proxy environment. It does not establish that idle policy caused the separate native06 0x100000EA failure. No clock, graphics or driver hooks.
